messages:
Maria: Looping in folks — Atlas Health wants a 12-mo reserve for a dedicated GPU pool (8x A100 eq) with autoscale + burst allowances. They asked to cap burst billing at 25% off list for first 3 months. Quote: https://redwood/quote/ATLAS-778
Devin: Quick q — what models & peak concurrency? Embeddings too?
Maria: Llama-2-70B (gen) + embeddings small, peak concurrent infer reqs ~120, avg seq 512. Expected committed spend ~$120k/mo, replacing ~70% hosted.
Jordan: Need ARR/MRR confirm to validate 25% band. Conservative ops — our standard burst discount bands top at 15% for commit size here.
Priya: Deal desk — we can't approve 25% by default. Provisional sign-off: 15% burst discount for first 3 months, 12-mo commit. Autoscale grace >10m needs Product sign-off + capacity carveout in contract.
Liam: Product — 15m autoscale grace is okay with policy. Must include fallback policy: if burst >2x sustained >5m, fallback to smaller model or throttling. Also add guardrails for node provisioning.
Ana: Legal — they requested BAA and have HIPAA needs. Need SOC2 docs + BAA executed before go-live.
Rachel: CS — Atlas has SOC2 Type II (verified). BAA is expected; I can get signatures but need Legal template.
Priya: Conditions for approval: (1) BAA signed, (2) fallback policy included, (3) explicit billing rule in contract for burst discounts/term. If all met, Deal Desk approves provisional pricing.
Jordan: I'll draft the quote with 12-mo term, committed $120k/mo, 15% burst discount for first 90 days, then standard burst pricing. Adding clause: "autoscale grace = 15m; sustained burst >5m triggers fallback".
Maria: thx. @Liam can you paste the fallback snippet we discussed?
Liam: Sure
```
autoscale_policy:
  max_burst_multiplier: 2.0
  burst_window: 15m
  sustained_threshold: 5m
  fallback_action: "switch-to-llama-2-70b-8bit" 
  billing_note: "burst discount 15% for first 90 days; thereafter standard burst rates"
```
Devin: One operational note — multi-region pool? Atlas asked for EU + US failover. We need to confirm cross-region latency and extra cost.
Liam: We can offer regional carveouts: primary pool in us-west, failover in eu-central; cross-region capacity is billed as separate pools. Need confirmation from Sales.
Priya: Noted. Approving provisional deal to Finance pending BAA. :white_check_mark:
Maria: Great — I'll update Atlas and attach draft quote. Ping me if Legal or Product need more.
Ana: I'll route BAA template to Rachel.
Jordan: I'll start the invoice and SOW draft.
Rachel: On it, will chase signatures.
Priya: Closing note — final approval when BAA signed + contract includes autoscale fallback + explicit billing clause.
Maria: Thanks team :pray:
